description: Defines the ControllerClientInterface class for managing media transcoding sessions, including submitting requests, canceling sessions, retrieving session info, and managing client UIDs.

classes.name: ControllerClientInterface
classes.description: Interface for clients to interact with the media transcoding controller, including session management methods.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a transcoding request to the controller.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a specific session or all sessions with a certain priority.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific session.

methods.name: addClientUid
methods.description: Adds an additional client UID requesting a session.

methods.name: getClientUids
methods.description: Retrieves list of all client UIDs requesting a session.
